description.p: TimeTrack records where your time goes: log finished work with quick-add buttons or manual entries, then review week totals, per-project breakdowns and recent entries.

ul.li: Quick-add 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes to a project
Manual entries with explicit start and end times
Week totals, per-project history and CSV export
A graphical interface and a terminal client, both talking to one service
